content.text:
The first fix only covered half the problem. The app no longer deletes those tasks, but the prompts still led the model to skip them when it wrote the recap. I fixed that side now. I still can't build or run it here because there's no `node_modules` and npm is blocked, so none of this is tested.

**Why Priya's task was still missing:**
- **Team Meet mode.** The default instruction for its "Action Items" section was "All action items that were said **I** would do after the meeting." A task Priya owns doesn't count under that, so the model left it out. If you record meetings in Team Meet mode, this was almost certainly the cause.
- **The other model's prompt.** The recap is sometimes written by a second AI service (Groq), which has its own prompt. Its only example action item had a date ("Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday"), which pushes the model toward dated tasks.
- **Shared rules.** Nothing in the rules both recap types use said that an assigned task with no date still counts.

**What I changed:**
- `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`: added two rules every recap uses. A task assigned to a person is an action item even with no date, and action items include anyone's tasks, not just yours.
- `electron/llm/prompts.ts`: the Groq prompt now has an example with no date ("Priya: Send the contract (no date given)") and says to include every assigned task.
- `electron/services/ModesManager.ts` and `electron/db/DatabaseManager.ts`: the default Team Meet "Action Items" text now asks for every task assigned to anyone, with the date only if one was given.

**Your existing Team Meet mode won't pick this up.** A mode that already exists keeps the old "I would do" text saved in its settings. Either edit that section's description in the mode settings, or I can add a one-time migration that updates the old default text automatically. The Sales and Recruiting modes have the same "only my items" wording, but I left those alone since that may be what you want there.

To test it, run `npm install`, then record a short meeting in the mode you normally use where someone says "Priya will send the contract" with no date. It should show up as "Priya: Send the contract".

The Sales and Recruiting modes have the same "only my items" wording, but I left those alone since that may be what you want there.

To test it, run `npm install`, then record a short meeting in the mode you normally use where someone says "Priya will send the contract" with no date. It should show up as "Priya: Send the contract".
